blocks.text:
MY 25 YEAR OLD COUSIN
TOLD ME: "I'll start investing
when I make more money."
That's backwards.

If you invest $200/month from
25 to 65 at 8%:
You contribute $96K. You end
up with roughly
$700K.

Waiting until 35 means
contributing $72K over 30
years and ending with roughly
$300K.

Your first investment isn't
about the money. It's about
buying time.

blocks.text:
Things to research when you're bored
to tears:

• the mirror stage (why babies
don't recognize themselves in mirrors
until a certain age)
• the uncanny valley (why almost-
human things unsettle us more than
obviously fake ones)
• the illusory truth effect (why
hearing a lie repeated enough times
makes it feel true)
• affective forecasting (why
you're consistently bad at predicting
how a future event will make you feel)
• the Dunbar number (why
humans can only maintain about 150
real relationships, ever)

BARE MINIMUM 💪

small things that aren't small for me;

texting first.
long hugs.
gives assurance.
i love you not 'ily'
do you wanna talk about it?
makes me feel valued.
remembers the small details about me.
'goodmorning i love you'
'goodnight sleep well i love you'
hold my hand when they see i'm
overwhelmed.
is excited when i'm excited.
doesn't get mad when i mess up.
understands me.
respect me.
loves me for me.
'i can't wait to see you'
makes time for me.
notices me when i'm off.
quick replies.
sending me reels that reminds of me.
EFFORT.
deep conversation.
'this made me think of you'
